# Setup channel assets - WxEngage standalone

Source: https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/setup-channel-assets
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:29:25+00:00

Channel assets act as the entry points for customers to reach your business's contact center.

| Channel                           | Channel Asset                    | Provisioning guide                                                                                         |
| :-------------------------------- | :------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| SMS                               | Longcode                         | <https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/phone-numbers>                                                          |
| Facebook                          | Facebook Page                    | [https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/facebook-messenger](https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/facebook-messenger) |
| Livechat                          | Livechat widget                  | <https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/mobile-web>                                                               |
| Email                             | Business mail server             | <https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/email>                                                                    |
| Apple Messages for Business (AMB) | AMB Account                      | <https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/messages-for-business-setup>                                              |
| WhatsApp Business                 | WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) | <https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/whatsapp>                                                                 |

> 📘 Note:
> 
> - SMS supports 'Longcodes' alone with Messaging capability.
> - Email supports SMTP-based assets alone.
